title: Olney Theatre Center

services.name: Field Trips
services.desc: Ever wondered how we make theatre magic happen? Now's your chance to go behind the scenes on a walking tour of Olney Theatre Center's campus. Get a close look at our performance spaces and backstage areas. Campus tours run between 30-60 minutes and led by our education and community engagement staff members. You'll learn some of the history of Olney Theatre Center, but mostly get a better understanding of what it takes to produce the plays and musicals here. If you are making a reservation on behalf of a school, please fill out the School Engagement Form online. One of our staff members will then contact you to confirm your reservation or ask clarifying questions. For all other inquiries,

services.name: Student Matinees
services.desc: The following Olney Theatre Center productions include 10:15 am performances in their schedule to accommodate school groups. In addition to the performance, there will be a 25 - 30 minute post show discussion with the cast and crew. These events are restricted to school groups of 10 or more students. Tickets are available on a sliding scale (see sidebar) with prices ranging from $5 for Title I schools to a maximum of $20 per student. We are committed to making our performances accessible to as many students as possible, so please do not assume your school cannot afford to come to the theatre.
